identity.resolvedIdentity: The preserved wood-pulp mill and central technical-industrial core at Kistefossen, distinct from generic Kistefos information points and the wider modern art destination.
identity.identityProblem: The modern Kistefos destination spans an industrial museum, sculpture park, art hall, two riverbanks and several entrances. The canonical record names the historic pulp mill and must therefore anchor to the factory core.
identity.splitReason: The pulp mill is one coherent industrial record. Wider protected and visitor areas remain context rather than separate canonical points in this record.

evidence.finding: The museum documents establishment in 1889, production from 1890 to 1955 and near-complete preservation of buildings and production equipment.
The museum calls the old pulp factory the heart of Kistefos and describes intact production rooms and machinery.
evidence.reason: Confirms that the factory core, not the sculpture park or visitor entrance, is the canonical subject.

evidence.finding: The 2025 protection covers the pulp mill and multiple connected industrial buildings, installations, work areas, roads, water and green structures.
evidence.reason: Defines the protected industrial complex and confirms the named heritage object.
